title: TD Social: tapping a WhatsApp or email alert opens that exact chat
text: A tap on a WhatsApp or email alert from the lock screen used to open only the WhatsApp or Inbox tab. It now opens the conversation the alert is about. This works with the app you already have.
points: Email alert opens that email, in the right mailbox
stepsTitle: Opening a chat from the lock screen

steps.name: Tap the alert
steps.detail: The app opens on that conversation.
